gaps: Poll rows were re-read from raw wikitext (step B2, scripts/forecast/fetch_il_history.py), span-aware. A merged list is ONE data cell spanning k header columns, so it is counted once and LABELLED by joining those k headers (2015 'Labor + Hatnuah' is the Zionist Union); the aliases map gives the canonical name. The earlier transcription summed those columns instead, which double-counted the merged list and pushed every such row off 120 -- that is why 2013 and 2015 previously held zero usable polls.

final_polls holds the 14 days before each election, de-duplicated on date plus pollster because one poll can appear in several of an article's tables. Exit polls are kept but tagged kind=exit_poll, which il_seat_sim's usable-poll filter rejects. Rows not totalling 120 +/- 2 are rejected, not rescaled; the per-election counts are in rejected_polls.
The 2013 article carries a poll dated '29 Feb', which does not exist in 2013. That row is dropped and reported rather than repaired.

September 2019: Zehut did not contest this election (poll tables show 'N/a' for it), so it is absent from both results and polls, consistent with the results article. Some polls omit Otzma Yehudit entirely (below the pollster's reporting cutoff) rather than giving a percentage; those are recorded with the party simply absent from that poll's seats dict.

2020: could not confirm any specific surplus (vote-sharing) agreements between separately-running lists for the 2020 election from the English Wikipedia article; the alliances found (Labor-Gesher-Meretz, Yamina, Joint List) were single joint lists, not surplus agreements between separate lists, so surplus_agreements is recorded as null rather than guessed.

2020: Otzma Yehudit polled at 0.42% of valid votes in the official result, just under the 0.5% inclusion cutoff for this file's results list, so it is omitted from results (but appears with seats:0 and pct_below in several final polls where pollsters showed it near/above threshold).

2021 poll from Maagar Mohot (16-18 Mar, Israel Hayom): United Arab List (Ra'am) was reported as a percentage (1.7%) rather than a seat count in that poll row; recorded as seats:0 with pct_below 1.7 accordingly.

2022 poll rows for Jewish Home and Balad on 2022-11-01 from Midgam/Channel 12 and Direct Polls/Channel 14 showed seats:0 with no percentage printed; pct_below left unset (not null-padded) for those two cells since no percentage was given.
